objective_pt: Responder às perguntas clássicas de entrevista ("Tell me about yourself", pontos fortes, experiência) com "I've been working as... for..." e fazer perguntas sobre a vaga.

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de trabalho atual e há quanto tempo.
prompts: How long have you been working there?
watchFor: Responder "I work with marketing" em vez de "I work in marketing".
Usar "since two years" em vez de "for two years".

exercises.prompt: So, tell me a little bit about yourself.
accepted: So, tell me a little bit about yourself
Tell me a little bit about yourself
So tell me a little about yourself

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você trabalha nessa empresa há três anos.
exercises.listen: How long have you been working at your current company?
accepted: For three years
I've been working there for three years
I have been working there for three years
I've been there for three years
I've worked there for three years
I have worked there for three years
About three years
Three years
For about three years now
I've been working at my current company for three years

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para duração use "for": "for three years". "Since" é para o ponto de início: "since 2021".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working there for three years.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Eu trabalho lá há três anos" usa o present perfect em inglês: "I've been working there for three years".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working there for three years.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual é a forma natural de dizer a sua área de trabalho?
exercises.explanation_pt: Para a área ou setor, use "work in": "I work in sales / in IT / in marketing". "Work with" é com quem ou com o quê você trabalha ("I work with children").

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender o vocabulário essencial de entrevista e currículo.
prompts: What would your last boss say about you?
watchFor: Dizer "I'm responsible of"; o certo é "responsible for".

exercises.example_en: One of my strengths is that I'm very organized.
I was in charge of a team of five people.
I'm applying for the marketing position.
This job needs good communication skills.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu sou responsável pelo atendimento ao cliente."
accepted: I'm responsible for customer service
I am responsible for customer service
I'm in charge of customer service
I am in charge of customer service
I'm responsible for the customer service
I take care of customer service
I handle customer service

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês é "responsible for", e não "responsible of" ou "by".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm responsible for customer service.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Atendimento" não é "attendance" (que é presença). Use "customer service".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm responsible for customer service.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar palavras de entrevista que brasileiros costumam errar: "career", "colleague", "résumé".
prompts: Say "career" and "Korea". Are they the same?
watchFor: Pronunciar "career" como "carrier" (transportadora); o som é "kuh-RIR", forte no final.
Pronunciar "colleague" com três sílabas ("co-le-gue"); são duas: "KÓ-lig".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Career" tem a força no final: ca-REER.
exercises.prompt: I want to build a career in finance.
accepted: I want to build a career in finance
I wanna build a career in finance

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Colleagues" tem só duas sílabas: KOL-leegz.
exercises.prompt: My colleagues would say I'm reliable and hardworking.
accepted: My colleagues would say I'm reliable and hardworking
My colleagues would say I am reliable and hardworking

exercises.instruction_pt: Em "career", qual sílaba é a forte?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Career" é ca-REER, com a força no final. Com a força no começo vira algo parecido com "carrier", que é outra palavra.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender perguntas de entrevista e responder de forma completa e educada.
prompts: Why do you want to work here?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
watchFor: Responder "Because yes" ou de forma curta demais; incentive "because" + motivo concreto.
Usar "I have interest in" em vez de "I'm interested in".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a candidata e escolha o resumo certo.
exercises.listen: I've been working as a nurse for six years, but I'm looking for a job with more regular hours.
options: Ela é enfermeira há seis anos e quer um horário mais regular.
Ela quer ser enfermeira daqui a seis anos.
Ela trabalhou como enfermeira por seis meses e gostou dos horários.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I've been working as a nurse for six years" = é enfermeira há seis anos. "More regular hours" = horários mais regulares.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga um ponto forte seu (por exemplo, que você é organizado).
exercises.listen: What would you say is your greatest strength?
accepted: I'm *
I'd say I'm *
My greatest strength is that I'm *
My greatest strength is *
I think my greatest strength is *
I work well in a team
I'm very good with people

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Organizado" é "organized", sem o "-at-" do português.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm very organized.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "my strength is" use "being organized" ou "that I'm organized".
commonErrors.correction_en: My greatest strength is that I'm organized.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você se interessa pela vaga porque quer aprender mais.
exercises.listen: Why are you interested in this position?
accepted: Because I want to learn more
I'm interested because I want to learn more
I'm interested in it because I want to learn more
Because I'd like to learn more
Because I want to keep learning
Because it's a great opportunity to learn more
I want to learn more and grow professionally
Because I want to grow and learn more

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tenho interesse" é "I'm interested", com o verbo "to be".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm interested because I want to learn more.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A preposição é "in": "interested in".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm interested in it because I want to learn more.

teacher.goal_pt: Simular uma entrevista: apresentar-se, falar da experiência e fazer uma pergunta ao final.
prompts: Tell me about your last job.
Why did you leave your last job?
Do you have any questions for us?
watchFor: Responder "No" a "Do you have any questions?"; é melhor fazer uma pergunta.
Usar "I worked there during two years"; o certo é "for two years".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu trabalho como desenvolvedor há cinco anos."
accepted: I've been working as a developer for five years
I have been working as a developer for five years
I've worked as a developer for five years
I have worked as a developer for five years
I've been a developer for five years
I have been a developer for five years

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Trabalho há cinco anos" (algo que começou no passado e continua) usa o present perfect: "I've been working".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working as a developer for five years.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Profissão no singular leva artigo: "as a developer".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working as a developer for five years.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ao final da entrevista, pergunte: "Como é um dia típico nessa função?"
accepted: What's a typical day like in this role
What is a typical day like in this role
What's a typical day like in this position
What does a typical day look like in this role
What does a typical day look like in this position
What's a typical day like for this role
What would a typical day look like in this role

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "like", a pergunta começa com "What": "What's it like?", "What does it look like?". "How is it like" é tradução de "como é".
commonErrors.correction_en: What's a typical day like in this role?

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: Why did you leave your last job?

exercises.instruction_pt: Responda à pergunta mais comum de entrevista.
exercises.prompt_en: Tell me about yourself and why you'd be a good fit for this job.
guidelines_pt: Diga o que você faz e há quanto tempo: "I've been working as... for...".
Cite um ponto forte com um exemplo concreto.
Termine dizendo por que você quer a vaga: "I'm interested in this position because...".

prompts: How long have you lived in your city?
What are you responsible for at work?

exercises.prompt: I've been in this field since 2020.
accepted: I've been in this field since 2020
I have been in this field since 2020
I've been in this field since twenty twenty

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu me candidatei à vaga de gerente."
accepted: I applied for the manager position
I applied for the manager job
I applied for the manager role
I applied for the position of manager
I applied for the management position
I've applied for the manager position
I have applied for the manager position

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para uma vaga, use "apply for": "I applied for the position". "Apply to" é para a empresa ou universidade.
commonErrors.correction_en: I applied for the manager position.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vacancy" existe, mas no dia a dia o natural é "position", "job" ou "role".
commonErrors.correction_en: I applied for the manager position.

accepted: in

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Interested" sempre leva "in": "interested in this position".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm really interested in this position.

practice.example_en: My biggest weakness is that I find it hard to say no.
I'm a team player, but I can also work on my own.

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. A força está em "ex" de "experience": ex-PE-ri-ence.
practice.prompt: I have a lot of experience in sales.
accepted: I have a lot of experience in sales
I've got a lot of experience in sales

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase, ligando "in charge of".
practice.prompt: In my last job, I was in charge of a team of five people.
accepted: In my last job, I was in charge of a team of five people
In my last job I was in charge of a team of 5 people

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Organized" tem a força no "OR".
practice.prompt: I'm very organized, and I'm good at meeting deadlines.
accepted: I'm very organized, and I'm good at meeting deadlines
I am very organized and I am good at meeting deadlines
I'm very organised, and I'm good at meeting deadlines

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a pergunta que o candidato faz no final.
practice.prompt: What are the next steps in the process?
accepted: What are the next steps in the process

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Been working" mostra uma ação que continua até hoje.
practice.prompt: I've been working in marketing for three years.
accepted: I've been working in marketing for three years
I have been working in marketing for 3 years

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase com calma e confiança.
practice.prompt: I'm looking for a new challenge.
accepted: I'm looking for a new challenge
I am looking for a new challenge

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Applied" soa "aplaid", sem sílaba extra.
practice.prompt: I applied for this position because I love working with people.
accepted: I applied for this position because I love working with people
I applied for this job because I love working with people

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu trabalho nessa empresa desde 2019."
accepted: I've worked at this company since 2019
I have worked at this company since 2019
I've been working at this company since 2019
I've worked for this company since 2019
I've been working for this company since 2019
I've been at this company since 2019

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que começou no passado e continua, use o present perfect: "I've worked... since 2019".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've worked at this company since 2019.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Desde" um ponto no tempo é "since", e não "from".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've worked at this company since 2019.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Meu ponto fraco é que eu sou perfeccionista."
accepted: My weakness is that I'm a perfectionist
My weak point is that I'm a perfectionist
My biggest weakness is that I'm a perfectionist
My weakness is that I am a perfectionist
My weakness is being a perfectionist

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Perfectionist" é substantivo: "I'm a perfectionist", com "a".
commonErrors.correction_en: My weakness is that I'm a perfectionist.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em entrevista, "ponto fraco" é "weakness" (ou "weak point").
commonErrors.correction_en: My weakness is that I'm a perfectionist.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu sou bom em resolver problemas."
accepted: I'm good at solving problems
I am good at solving problems
I'm good at problem solving
I'm good at fixing problems
I'm really good at solving problems

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Bom em" algo é "good at", e não "good in".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm good at solving problems.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "good at" o verbo vai com "-ing": "solving".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm good at solving problems.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu tenho experiência com atendimento ao cliente."
accepted: I have experience in customer service
I have experience with customer service
I've got experience in customer service
I have customer service experience
I have some experience in customer service

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Experiência profissional é incontável: "I have experience", sem "an" e sem plural.
commonErrors.correction_en: I have experience in customer service.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Atendimento ao cliente" é "customer service".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have experience in customer service.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Quando eu posso esperar uma resposta?"
accepted: When can I expect an answer
When can I expect a response
When can I expect to hear from you
When could I expect an answer
When will I hear back from you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Aqui "esperar" no sentido de "contar com" é "expect". "Wait for" é aguardar.
commonErrors.correction_en: When can I expect an answer?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em perguntas, o "can" vem antes do sujeito: "When can I...?"
commonErrors.correction_en: When can I expect an answer?

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga onde você se vê em cinco anos: liderando uma equipe.
practice.listen: Where do you see yourself in five years?
accepted: I see myself leading a team
In five years, I see myself leading a team
I'd like to be leading a team
I hope to be leading a team
I see myself as a team leader
I'd like to be managing a team

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Quando o sujeito e o objeto são a mesma pessoa, use "myself": "I see myself...".
commonErrors.correction_en: I see myself leading a team.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "see myself" o verbo vai com "-ing": "leading".
commonErrors.correction_en: I see myself leading a team.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga por que você saiu: queria crescer na carreira.
practice.listen: What made you decide to leave your previous job?
accepted: I wanted to grow in my career
Because I wanted to grow in my career
I wanted more opportunities to grow
I was looking for new challenges
I wanted to grow professionally
I left because I wanted to grow in my career

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Grow up" é crescer como pessoa (virar adulto). Na carreira, diga só "grow".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wanted to grow in my career.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em entrevista, evite falar mal do chefe antigo. Foque no que você busca: "I wanted to grow".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wanted to grow in my career.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que pode começar daqui a duas semanas.
practice.listen: When would you be able to start?
accepted: I could start in two weeks
I can start in two weeks
In two weeks
I'd be able to start in two weeks
I could start in two weeks' time
I'm available in two weeks

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Daqui a duas semanas" é "in two weeks".
commonErrors.correction_en: I could start in two weeks.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "can" e "could" não vem "to": "I can start".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can start in two weeks.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que sim: pergunte sobre as oportunidades de treinamento.
practice.listen: Do you have any questions for us?
accepted: Yes. What training opportunities do you offer
Yes, what kind of training do you offer
Yes, are there any training opportunities
Yes. Do you offer any training
Yes, I'd like to know about training opportunities
Yes, what training opportunities are there

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dizer que não tem perguntas passa falta de interesse. Faça uma pergunta sobre a vaga.
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes. What training opportunities do you offer?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Training" é incontável: "training opportunities", sem "s".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes. What training opportunities do you offer?

practice.instruction_pt: Você está numa entrevista de emprego. Responda ao entrevistador.
practice.scene_pt: Entrevista para uma vaga de analista numa empresa internacional.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Thanks for coming in today. Could you start by telling me about your current role?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que trabalha como analista de dados há três anos.
accepted: I've been working as a data analyst for three years
I've worked as a data analyst for three years
I'm a data analyst, and I've been in this role for three years
I have been a data analyst for three years
I've been a data analyst for three years

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "for three years" (até hoje), use o present perfect: "I've been working".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working as a data analyst for three years.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com um período (três anos) use "for", e não "since".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working as a data analyst for three years.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: And what are you responsible for?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é responsável pelos relatórios mensais.
accepted: I'm responsible for the monthly reports
I'm in charge of the monthly reports
I am responsible for the monthly reports
I'm responsible for monthly reports
I'm in charge of monthly reports

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Responsável por" é "responsible for".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm responsible for the monthly reports.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "in charge of".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm in charge of the monthly reports.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Great. What would you say is your biggest weakness?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que às vezes tem dificuldade para delegar, mas que está melhorando.
accepted: Sometimes I find it hard to delegate, but I'm getting better
Sometimes I find it difficult to delegate, but I'm improving
I sometimes find it hard to delegate, but I'm getting better at it
Sometimes I have trouble delegating, but I'm getting better
Sometimes it's hard for me to delegate, but I'm improving

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "have difficulty" ou "have trouble" use "-ing": "delegating".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sometimes I have trouble delegating, but I'm getting better.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I'm better" é "já estou melhor". "Estou melhorando" é "I'm getting better" ou "I'm improving".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sometimes I find it hard to delegate, but I'm getting better.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: That's fair. Why do you want to work here?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que admira os projetos da empresa e quer um novo desafio.
accepted: I admire your company's projects and I want a new challenge
I really admire your projects, and I'm looking for a new challenge
I admire the company's projects and I'd like a new challenge
I admire your projects and I want a new challenge
Because I admire your projects and I'm looking for a new challenge

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Desafio" é "challenge".
commonErrors.correction_en: I admire your projects and I'm looking for a new challenge.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O natural é usar o possessivo: "the company's projects" ou "your projects".
commonErrors.correction_en: I admire the company's projects and I want a new challenge.

practice.instruction_pt: Responda como numa entrevista de verdade.
practice.prompt_en: Tell me about a difficult situation at work and how you dealt with it.
guidelines_pt: Conte a situação no passado simples: "Last year, we had a problem with...".
Diga o que você fez: "I decided to...".
Termine com o resultado: "In the end...".

practice.instruction_pt: Qual resposta é melhor para "What are your strengths?"
options: I'm reliable and I learn quickly.
practice.explanation_pt: Fale de qualidades concretas, como "reliable" (confiável) e "I learn quickly".

practice.instruction_pt: Complete: "I've been working here ___ three years."
practice.explanation_pt: Com um período de tempo use "for". "Since" é para o ponto de início ("since 2021").

practice.instruction_pt: Complete com a preposição: "I'm applying ___ the position of sales manager."
practice.sentence: I'm applying ___ the position of sales manager.
accepted: for

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Candidatar-se a uma vaga é "apply for". "Apply to" é para a empresa ou instituição.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm applying for the position of sales manager.

practice.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: Why are you interested in this role?
